notes: Closed is treated as off and open as on. The two movable leaves of each double-door closet are reported separately. The initial apartment survey and the final approach toward the living-room console show no supported state-changing manipulation and are not counted.
scene_description: A fisheye first-person traversal of an apartment entry hall, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. Visible manipulations open and later close two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer.
